content.short: Synaps verifies identities online and supports compliance and decentralization of identity.
content.description: Synaps helps organizations meet compliance requirements while enabling users to decentralize their identity, delivering a frictionless, borderless Web3 experience. The platform prioritizes fraud detection and risk mitigation and supports adherence to both local and global regulations. With KYC/AML and KYB capabilities, Synaps accelerates online verifications, streamlines workflows, and enhances user experience across multichain ecosystems.
content.meta: Synaps helps meet compliance and decentralize identity for a frictionless Web3 experience. Discover Synaps and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
